announcements.title: Ward Temple Night This Friday
announcements.content: Join us this Friday at 7 PM for a ward temple night. We will meet at the temple parking lot and carpool together. Please RSVP to the ward clerk.

announcements.title: Youth Service Project
announcements.content: Youth aged 12-18 are invited to a service project Saturday morning at 9 AM. We will be helping elderly members with yard work. Bring gloves and yard tools.

announcements.title: Relief Society Meeting Tuesday
announcements.content: All sisters are invited to join us for Relief Society meeting on Tuesday at 7 PM in the cultural hall. Sister Johnson will be speaking about strengthening families.

announcements.title: Elders Quorum Service Opportunity
announcements.content: Brothers, we need volunteers to help with yard work for elderly members this Saturday from 9 AM to noon. Please sign up in the foyer.

announcements.title: Primary Presentation Practice
announcements.content: Primary children will practice for the sacrament meeting presentation next Sunday. Practice will be Saturday at 10 AM in the chapel.

announcements.title: Ward Choir Rehearsal
announcements.content: Ward choir rehearsal will be held every Wednesday at 7:30 PM in the chapel. All are welcome to join, no experience necessary!

announcements.title: Baptism This Saturday
announcements.content: We are pleased to announce the baptism of Emma Williams this Saturday at 2 PM. All are invited to attend and support Emma as she takes this important step.

announcements.title: Ward Picnic Next Month
announcements.content: Save the date! The annual ward picnic will be held on the last Saturday of next month at the park. More details to follow.

announcements.title: Seminary Registration
announcements.content: Youth entering 9th grade should register for seminary. Registration forms are available in the foyer or online on the ward website.

announcements.title: Food Drive for Local Shelter
announcements.content: We are collecting non-perishable food items for the local homeless shelter. Please bring donations to the cultural hall before the end of the month.

announcements.title: Marriage and Family Night
announcements.content: Couples are invited to a marriage enrichment evening on Friday, March 29th at 7 PM. Light refreshments will be served.

announcements.title: Missionary Farewell
announcements.content: Elder David Thompson will be speaking before leaving for his mission to Tokyo, Japan. Please join us in wishing him well on his missionary service.

announcements.title: Book Club Meeting
announcements.content: The ward book club will meet on the first Thursday of next month to discuss 'The Hiding Place' by Corrie ten Boom. All sisters are welcome.

announcements.title: Basketball League Signup
announcements.content: Men's basketball league is starting soon! Sign up sheets are available in the gym. Games will be on Tuesday and Thursday evenings.

announcements.title: Visiting Teaching Conference
announcements.content: All Relief Society sisters are invited to attend the stake visiting teaching conference on Saturday morning at 9 AM at the stake center.

musicProgram.sacramentHymnTitle: As Now We Take the Sacrament
